newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RUSH SIGNS FOR DALGLISH AT NEWCASTLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSH SIGNS FOR DALGLISH AT NEWCASTLE.

text.p: Former Liverpool striker Ian Rush teamed up with his old Anfield team mate and manager Kenny Dalglish by signing a one-year deal with Newcastle on Friday evening.

The 35-year-old player was given a free transfer by Leeds, and Magpies boss Dalglish -- desperately short of firepower after the loss of injured Alan Shearer and transferred Les Ferdinand -- swooped to sign the Welsh international.
This latest signing comes just 48 hours after Dalglish secured another of his former charges, John Barnes, again on a free transfer, from Liverpool.

Rush signed in time to play in the European Champions' League but is not eligible for the second leg of the preliminary round tie against Croatia Zagreb on August 27. Newcastle lead 2-1 from the first leg with the winner advancing to the Champions' League.
